    ('2022-06-01', '2022-06-30'), # Jun 2022
    ('2022-07-01', '2022-07-31'), # Jul 2022
]

# Logic: A record is open if:
# 1. It was not closed before the first day of the month (Date Closed >= first day OR Date Closed is NaT)
# 2. It was not created after the last day of the month (Date Created <= last day)

results = []

    row_results = []
    created = row['Date Created']
    closed = row['Date Closed']

        start_date = pd.to_datetime(start_str)
        end_date = pd.to_datetime(end_str)
        
        # Condition 1: Not closed before the first day of the month
        # If closed is NaT, it's still open. If closed >= start_date, it was open during the month.
        is_not_closed_before = pd.isna(closed) or closed >= start_date
        
        # Condition 2: Not created after the last day of the month
        is_not_created_after = created <= end_date
        
        if is_not_closed_before and is_not_created_after:
            row_results.append(1)
        else:
            row_results.append(0)
    results.append(row_results)
